# Support

Use the route that matches your request:

- **Questions and ideas:** start a thread in [Discussions](https://github.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/discussions).
- **A broken rule, site, or tool:** open an issue with the matching form in [New issue](https://github.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/issues/new/choose).
- **A security vulnerability:** use [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/security/advisories/new). Do not post it publicly.
- **A conduct concern:** follow the private reporting route in the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

Before opening a request, search the [documentation site](https://szmelc-inc.github.io/CONVENTIONS.md/) and existing issues or Discussions. This is a maintainer-led project; response times are goals, not guarantees. See [governance](https://github.com/Szmelc-INC/CONVENTIONS.md/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md) for review and decision policies.
